Subject: Next steps: SageHealth compliance questions + SOC 2/ISO scoping

Hi Tom / Emily —

Thanks again for taking time on the call earlier. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call highlights (from our side):
- SageHealth current posture: in-progress SOC 2 Type II (gap assessment started; target audit H2 2028).
- Regulation needs: core product handles PHI in limited flows — you mentioned HIPAA compliance and GDPR obligations for EU patients.
- Potential future requirement: one of your federal pilots may push a FedRAMP-like attestation requirement in 2029.

Immediate asks we committed to:
1) Share a short SOC 2 + ISO 27001 scoping note (attached) that maps where Redwood typically sits in customer scopes.
2) Send our vendor security questionnaire (xlsx) and a link for an engineering deep-dive with our Solutions team.
3) Fill initial questionnaire fields where you can (we only need high-level answers to scope the work).

Attachments: redwood-soc2-overview.pdf (high-level mapping), vendor-security-questionnaire-redwood.xlsx (fillable).

Proposed near-term timeline:
- By Tue 24 Aug: initial questionnaire filled (even draft answers are fine).
- Week of 31 Aug: 60-min security deep dive with Evelyn Hart (solutions engineer) and your architect/infosec.
- Early Sep: scoped statement of work for SOC scope expansion / ISO alignment if needed.

If helpful I can also propose a short mutual action plan linking milestones to procurement triggers (budget/PO/demo).

Thanks again — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Logan —

Appreciate the recap. A couple of clarifications and a few quick answers inline below.

SOC 2 status: correct — we are doing a gap assessment now. Target audit window is Nov 2028 (Type II). Our internal security team will probably ask Redwood for: evidence of data segmentation, logging retention, and a formal incident response flow.

HIPAA/GDPR: we handle PHI for US patients; for EU users we pseudonymize patient identifiers but still track consent. GDPR Data Processing Agreement will be required; HIPAA BAA is required.

FedRAMP: not immediate but flagged as a potential future procurement requirement. If Redwood has an experience note or examples of supporting customers through FedRAMP-like readiness that would be useful.

Questionnaire: I attached a rough dataflow image and filled a couple of the high-level fields in your spreadsheet (see attached). We didn’t complete everything — our security SME (Emily) will help with the rest.

We’re available for a deep-dive on Tue 1 Sep 10:00am PT — does that work for your team?

Tom
CTO, SageHealth
